guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the lowest margin per chair hour, the overhead per chair hour, the deposit, the local sales tax and your usual discounts.

Check Services. Each row is a service with its minutes, price, product cost, deposit and pay. Margin per chair hour (what a service leaves after product and pay for each hour of a chair) and the verdict fill in.
Set the lowest margin per hour and per cent for each category on Margin Targets. Services below their target show amber, services that earn less than the overhead show red.
Keep Service Months and Appointments up to date from your booking system export. Margin per appointment, per month and per chair hour calculate themselves.
List the items you use on Items and the quantity used in each service on Product Use. The Services sheet compares the cost from the list with the product cost you typed.
Write every price change on Price History with its reason, and every test on Price Tests. You see the change percent and what the test earned.
Use Promotions, Discount Rules and Combos and Add-ons to see what each offer cost, the lowest price allowed and the margin of a combo.
Record the prices of nearby studios on Nearby Studio Prices. The Services sheet shows which services are priced below or above them.
Set Deposit Rules and read Overhead by Month: it shows your overhead for each booked chair hour against the plan.
Time services on Time Study and plan every rise on Price Rise Plan with the clients you expect to lose and the monthly gain.
Use the 14 calculators for the price to charge, margin, discounts, promotions, price rises, packages, combos, deposits, pay models, time, product cost, nearby prices and what-ifs.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in. Check your own local rules before you use any wording.
Read the Menu and Margin Dashboard and the Charts every month: revenue, margin, discounts, overhead, time over plan and nearby prices.

listing.title: Beauty Studio Service Menu and Pricing Excel Template: Margin per Chair Hour, Price Rises, Promotions, Deposits, Combos
listing.headline: Price every service so each hour of a chair earns what it should
listing.description:
Run the pricing side of a small lash, brow, nail and skin-care studio in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-technician with 3 to 5 technicians, employees and booth renters (a technician who rents a chair and keeps their own takings), and a front desk. The Services sheet lists every service with its minutes, price, product cost, deposit and pay, and works out the margin per service and the margin per chair hour, which is what a service leaves after product and pay for each hour of a chair. A service that earns less than the studio overhead is flagged red.

Service Months and Appointments show revenue, product cost, pay and margin by service, month and technician. Price History and Price Tests record every price change and test with the result. Promotions, Discount Rules and Combos and Add-ons show what each offer cost and the margin it leaves, and Nearby Studio Prices shows which services cost less or more than studios around you. Deposit Rules, Overhead by Month, Product Use and Time Study give the deposit to hold, the overhead for each booked chair hour, the cost of the products in a service and the margin lost when a service runs over its booked time. Price Rise Plan adds the new margin per hour and the monthly gain after the clients you expect to lose.

14 calculators cover the price to charge, margin, discounts, promotions, price rises, packages, combos, deposits, commission against hourly pay, time over plan, product cost, nearby prices and a price and volume grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready text messages to clients, technicians, the front desk, the supplier, the accountant and the owner.

This is part one of the Beauty Studio suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. It helps you plan your prices and does not promise results.

tr.Record the prices of nearby studios on N: Yakındaki stüdyoların fiyatlarını Yakındaki stüdyo fiyatları'a kaydedin. Hizmetler sayfasında hangi hizmetlerin bunların altında veya üstünde fiyatlandırıldığı gösterilir.
tr.Set Deposit Rules and read Overhead by M: Para yatırma kuralları'ı ayarlayın ve Aya göre genel gider'i okuyun: bu, plana göre rezerve edilen her sandalye saati için ek yükünüzü gösterir.

tr.Use the 14 calculators for the price to: Ücretlendirme fiyatı, marj, indirimler, promosyonlar, fiyat artışları, paketler, kombinasyonlar, mevduatlar, ödeme modelleri, süre, ürün maliyeti, yakın fiyatlar ve olası durumlar için 14 hesaplayıcıyı kullanın.
tr.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: 10 sayfa ve 10 belge yazdırın, 10 kontrol listesini takip edin ve ayrıntıların önceden yazılmış olduğu bir metin göndermek için bir mesaj bağlantısına dokunun. Herhangi bir ifade kullanmadan önce kendi yerel kurallarınızı kontrol edin.
tr.Read the Menu and Margin Dashboard and t: Her ay Menü ve kenar boşluğu kontrol paneli ve Grafikleri okuyun: gelir, marj, indirimler, genel gider, plan aşımı süresi ve yakın fiyatlar.
tr.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Bu dosyadaki tüm açılır listeler. Bir öğenin adını burada değiştirin; değişiklik tüm sayfalara yansır.
tr.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Sayfalardaki verilerle otomatik güncellenir. Geçmişe bakmak için yılı değiştirin.
tr.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Sarı hücreden seçim yapın; diğer alanlar otomatik dolar. Yazdırmaya hazır.
tr.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Metni burada düzenleyin; {braces} içindeki ifadeler her satırdaki verilerle doldurulur. Bağlantılar tablolardadır.
tr.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Bir kayıt seçin: her adımın tamamlanma tarihi buna göre belirlenir. Her kayıt için bu sayfanın bir kopyasını oluşturun.
